tools.name: shift4shop_list_orders
tools.description: List store orders, filterable by status, order (invoice) number, date range, last-update range or billing email. Use this first to find orders. Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its id (the invoice number), with customer, totals and status. Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders/{orderid}.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_order_items
tools.description: List the line items of one order (products, quantities, prices). Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders/{orderid}/Items.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_order_shipments
tools.description: List the shipments recorded for one order, including tracking data. Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders/{orderid}/Shipments.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_order_transactions
tools.description: List the payment transactions recorded for one order. Shift4Shop API: GET /Orders/{orderid}/Transactions.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List the order statuses configured in the store (use their ids or names in shift4shop_list_orders). Shift4Shop API: GET /OrderStatus.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_customers
tools.description: List store customers, filterable by email, name, country, state, city, phone or last-update range. Shift4Shop API: GET /Customers.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with contact and billing details. Shift4Shop API: GET /Customers/{id}.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_products
tools.description: List catalog products, filterable by SKU, name, cost or price range, stock range and flags (hidden, on sale, not for sale). Shift4Shop API: GET /Products.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its catalog id, with price, stock and description. Shift4Shop API: GET /Products/{catalogid}.

tools.name: shift4shop_list_categories
tools.description: List the store's product categories. Shift4Shop API: GET /Categories.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_category
tools.description: Get one product category by id. Shift4Shop API: GET /Categories/{categoryid}.

tools.name: shift4shop_get_store_settings
tools.description: Get the store's general settings (store name, currency and other configuration). Shift4Shop API: GET /StoreSettings.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shift4shop_list_orders, shift4shop_list_customers · Private data: shift4shop_get_customer · Public sink: shift4shop_list_orders, shift4shop_list_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shift4shop_list_orders, shift4shop_list_customers · Private data: shift4shop_get_customer · Public sink: shift4shop_list_orders, shift4shop_list_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
